## About
We're a family owned and operated auto body shop on Payne Ave, in the historic Payne-Phalen neighborhood of St. Paul. We work on collision damage, bumpers, windshields, mirrors and dents, and we have an on site frame rack.
We try to give the best quality, affordable work. We also offer a full line of detailing services, and we run specials on a regular basis. If you're dealing with a claim, let us help you through it.
Our customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 76 Google reviews. Feel free to give us a call.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairing body damage after an accident.
- On site Frame Rack: Frame work done right here in our shop.
- Bumper Repair/Replace: We fix damaged bumpers or replace them.
- Discounted out of pocket repair: For repairs you're paying for yourself.
- Windshield Replacement
- Mirror Replacement
- Car/Truck Accessories
- Paint-less Dent Removal

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my claim?
A: Yes. Let us assist you with your claims process.

Q: Do you offer loaner cars?
A: We offer free loaner cars with qualifying insurance repairs, by appointment.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. Mobile and email estimates are available. Give us a call or send us an email.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept cash, money orders, cashiers checks and major credit cards. There is a 3% surcharge on credit card payments.
